During the later [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] flew a red '''Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptor'''. It was identical in color to [[Ahsoka's Delta-7B Jedi Starfighter/Legends|her previous starfighter]], and also carried [[R7-A7/Legends|R7-A7]] as her co-pilot.
